reason: This PR directly changes index join selection logic in core planner/executor paths (`pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`, `pkg/executor/builder.go`). Join-choice changes are optimizer-semantic and runtime-sensitive: they can introduce wrong-plan selection, correctness edge cases, or major regressions across many queries. The added planner integration test further suggests user-visible SQL behavior is changing, so this is central and risky enough for a focused deep review.
